notes:
Implemented all 7 LLM agent modules in /root/projects/guest-checkin/app/agent/:

1. llm_client.py — OllamaClient with async httpx, configurable retries/timeout, OllamaUnavailableError on exhaustion
2. prompt_builder.py — PromptBuilder generates state-aware system prompts with persona, state-specific instructions, FAQ, conversation guidelines, and session context
3. intent.py — IntentDetector uses Ollama LLM for classification, falls back to FallbackAgent regex patterns. State-aware (e.g., 'correct' → agree in INFO_VERIFY_PENDING)
4. entity_extractor.py — EntityExtractor uses LLM with JSON extraction prompts, falls back to regex for phone/name/OTP/selection_type
5. tool_router.py — ToolRouter maps (intent, state) → MCP tool call with entity-to-kwarg mapping. Handles all 8 state+intent combos, plus question→get_faq, request_help→no_tool, other→no_tool. Special case: agree+INFO_VERIFY_PENDING with otp_code switches from trigger_otp to verify_otp
6. fallback.py — FallbackAgent with ordered regex patterns (decline before agree to handle negations) and template responses for each state+intent combination
7. exceptions.py — OllamaUnavailableError, IntentDetectionError, EntityExtractionError

90 unit tests all passing (test_agent.py). Build compiles clean. Mocked Ollama, no external dependencies needed.
